The campus budget risk calculator successfully passed all validation tests with a perfect reward score, demonstrating a robust initial implementation.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.88 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.33s. While the logic is functional, future iterations should re-check the weighting assumptions in the matrix-skill-none-diffusion model to ensure edge-case stability.
